identified_code_defects.evidence: Legacy bridge returned -1 for native map mode NONE, which the native controller uses before initialization.
identified_code_defects.fix: Null and NONE wait. Only confirmed route/navigation modes cancel.

identified_code_defects.evidence: Legacy bridge returned 1 immediately after Lamcr.f(); f() can be a no-op when already tracking, or only dispatch asynchronous permission/camera callbacks.
identified_code_defects.fix: Issue the direct, guarded native camera operation. Return 2 means issued; return 1 requires active LOCATION_ONLY or COMPASS tracking, the native camera target less than 50 m from a copied valid fix, and zoom >= 13.

identified_code_defects.evidence: Legacy runtime required a shown, enabled, attached current-location button even though native controller readiness can be validated directly. This was an unnecessary gate; button absence on the user device was not observed.
identified_code_defects.fix: Use window focus, controller lifecycle, map mode, renderer readiness, and a valid location fix.
